text: The purpose of this report is to provide Toronto Parking Authority Board of Directors with an update on the status of the transition of Toronto Parking Authority’s rental property portfolio to the City of Toronto's Corporate Real Estate Management division, under the City-Wide Real Estate Model. Implementation of a centralized real estate service delivery model is in progress and it is anticipated that the transfer of Toronto Parking Authority’s rental portfolio will begin in the third quarter of 2022. Toronto Parking Authority has a commercial and residential rental portfolio comprised of 35 units accounting for over 7,000 square metres across 17 properties. The tenancies are varied in use including retail, office, car wash operations and residential. The entire rental portfolio generated a Gross Revenue of $693,809 in 2020.
